topic: Daily routine, part 1: what do you do

phrases.when: “Hacés” is the vos form. It asks about your job or what you are doing these days; the answer is a short sentence.
“Trabajo” is “I work”. Swap “una oficina” for “un hospital” or “una escuela”.
Use “estudio” for school, university or learning on your own. Spanish is “español”, no capital letter.
“Vivís” is the vos form, stressed at the end. Answer with “Vivo en...” and your city.
